name: Google Cloud AlloyDB
description: Google Cloud AlloyDB for PostgreSQL with Auth Proxy / language connectors, IAM database auth, connection pooling, pgvector, and columnar engine conventions.
verification_commands: pg_isready -h "${ALLOYDB_PROXY_HOST:-127.0.0.1}" -p "${ALLOYDB_PROXY_PORT:-5432}"  # verify AlloyDB Auth Proxy or local PostgreSQL test listener readiness
psql "${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://127.0.0.1:5432/{{PROJECT_SLUG}}}" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "SELECT 1;"  # verify AlloyDB/PostgreSQL connectivity and migration baseline

evaluators.name: AlloyDB Data, Security & Performance Evaluator
evaluators.scope: AlloyDB Auth Proxy / language connector TLS and IAM database authentication, bounded connection pools, transactional migration safety, pgvector indexing, and columnar engine analytical queries.

single_concurrency_locks: AlloyDB Auth Proxy / Local DB Port: Only 1 subagent at a time may bind the local AlloyDB Auth Proxy port (`5432`) or run stateful migrations/integration tests against a shared local database instance.
pr_checklist: AlloyDB connections use Language Connectors or the AlloyDB Auth Proxy with IAM authentication and bounded connection pools (no unencrypted public IP access)
Schema migrations are transactional/zero-downtime safe, and any `pgvector` (`scann`/`hnsw`/`ivfflat`) or columnar engine changes include `EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS)` verification
agents_md_rules: **AlloyDB & Vector/Columnar:** Follow [`.agents/skills/data-alloydb/SKILL.md`](.agents/skills/data-alloydb/SKILL.md) (Auth Proxy/Language Connectors + IAM DB auth, pooled connections, transactional migrations, `pgvector` & columnar engine).
